title: Access control policy
summary: Define and approve who may access which systems and data, and review the policy at least annually.

title: Multi-factor authentication
summary: Require MFA for remote access, privileged accounts, and access to sensitive systems.

title: Access reviews
summary: Review user and privileged access periodically and remove access that is no longer needed.

title: Asset inventory
summary: Maintain an up-to-date inventory of hardware, software, and data assets with named owners.

title: Incident response plan
summary: Document how incidents are detected, triaged, escalated, contained, and reviewed; test the plan.

title: Security logging and monitoring
summary: Collect security-relevant logs centrally, protect them from tampering, and alert on anomalies.

title: Vulnerability management
summary: Scan systems regularly and remediate vulnerabilities within risk-based timeframes.

title: Backup and recovery
summary: Back up critical data, store copies separately, and test restores on a schedule.

title: Third-party risk management
summary: Assess vendors before onboarding and periodically, based on the data and access they receive.

title: Data classification
summary: Classify data by sensitivity and apply handling rules (encryption, retention, sharing) per class.
